provenance: HELD-OUT, FROZEN AT AUTHORING 2026-08-28 — labels written and committed BEFORE the filing was ever put through this repo's pipeline, per evals/heldout/README.md. The SECOND of the two replacements owed after ADR-042 §h. Super Micro Computer, Inc. FY2024 10-K (fiscal year ended JUNE 30, 2024 — a non-December year end, which the corpus is thin on), sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1375365/000137536525000004/smci-20240630.htm, accession 0001375365-25-000004, 3,650,146 bytes, iXBRL. WHY THIS FILING: it is the LATE one. Super Micro filed a Form 12b-25 NT 10-K on 2024-08-28 (accession 0001375365-24-000031) saying it could not file this report on time, and the 10-K itself arrived months later after an auditor resignation and an Audit Committee review. Two distinct things follow, and only the first is this case. (1) The 10-K is a REAL annual report and must extract normally despite the chronology — a late filing is not a malformed one, and a pipeline that treats lateness as a defect signal would be wrong. Its structure is in fact the cleanest in the whole sweep: the blind scan finds all 23 item codes at exactly 2 occurrences each, the ideal TOC-plus-body pattern, and item 16 at 1. Part III is INLINE (item 10 carries a real directors-and-officers table dated as of January 31, 2025), not incorporated by reference — a late filer often cannot rely on a proxy that does not exist yet, which is why `item_present 10 = extracted` is asserted rather than IBR. (2) The NT 10-K itself is a WRONG-FORM refusal question and is deliberately NOT part of this held-out case — it is `evals/adversarial/smci-nt10k-wrong-form.json`, because a refusal has a known answer and belongs in a suite that can be watched red, not in a set whose purpose is to estimate generalization. ANCHORS, verified by `tasks/reviews/heldout_blind_scan.py` (imports nothing from src/), counts raw/stripped: 'We are a Silicon Valley-based provider of total IT solutions' 1/1, 'Our business involves significant risks, some of which are described below' 1/1, 'The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements' 1/1, 'Index to Consolidated Financial Statements' 2/2. Three of the four occur exactly once, which is the ideal the skill names; the fourth is the TOC-plus-body pattern. LENGTH BANDS from the filing's own TOC page ranges (item 1 pages 1-11, 1A 11-43, 7 49-62, 8 63-121), set well below the implied size so the band tests presence of the body rather than a guess about normalization.
